decisions.reason: As a still-recent launch squarely within the firm's core coolant-management business, sunk development effort, prior public commitment and strong strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge remains closely aligned with the firm's established process-media and sustainability offering, so management is inclined to continue justifying and supporting the investment.

Because the nozzle range is a multi-model extension of the existing portfolio that likely supports broader system sales, a large German machinery firm would be especially reluctant to remove it quickly.
This magnetic belt chip conveyor reinforces the firm's established chip-handling systems portfolio, and keeping it is consistent with prior commitments and a broad-solution strategy.

Although somewhat less central than the coolant-focused products, the hinged belt chip conveyor is still adjacent to the firm's automation and conveying activities, so management would usually give it further time rather than reverse course now.
